name: Braided by Nai
description: Braided by Nai is a braider known for crisp parts and creative designs — zig-zag stitch braids, men's cornrow designs, knotless braids, and twists for men, women, and kids.

hero.title: Clean parts. Creative braids.
hero.subtitle: Zig-zag stitch braids, cornrow designs, knotless braids, and twists for men, women, and kids — book your braids with Nai today.

stylists.name: Nai
stylists.title: Owner & Braider
stylists.bio: Nai is the braider behind Braided by Nai, known for clean, crisp parts and creative zig-zag designs. From men's stitch braids and cornrow designs to knotless braids and twists, every style is neat, detailed, and made to last.

reviews.name: Marcus J.
reviews.text: Nai's zig-zag stitch braids are crazy clean. Parts were perfect and they lasted weeks.

reviews.name: Tiana R.
reviews.text: My knotless braids came out so neat and light. Best braider I've been to, hands down.

reviews.name: Devon K.
reviews.text: Got a cornrow design for my birthday and everybody asked who did it. Fast and professional.

reviews.name: Aisha B.
reviews.text: She braided my son's hair and was so patient with him. He loved his zig-zags!
